text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the Mejiros— there is a specialist 
in long distances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent stayer who won the 
Kikuka-sho and achieved back-to-back 
victories in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So, Bright, Trainer-san. You are saying 
you want me to do training meant for long 
distances?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm counting on you, Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I humbly ask of you. I simply must run 
brilliantly in the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wish to make a contribution like yours, 
Lady McQueen~. For the sake of the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of Mejiro... Bright, I know 
that has always been your wish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then allow me to lend you a 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the long-distance training led by 
Mejiro McQueen began, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Lady McQueen~. I 
have never run for such a long time in my 
life~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My heart is thumping so fast, and the 
world is spinning round and round~ I can 
barely catch my breath~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's because your cardiopulmonary 
function hasn't caught up. To begin with, 
what's demanded in spring versus autumn of 
the Classic year is completely 
different...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, to run well in all three crown 
races, one must overcome a massive hurdle 
during the summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Derby's 2400m and the Kikuka 
Sho's 3000m. Overcoming that 600m 
difference requires a tremendous amount of 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
During my Classic year, I deliberately 
overlooked the Spring Classics and focused 
solely from the Kikuka Sho to the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). Which means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She only won because she specialized in 
long distances from an early stage. In 
other words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"For those who aren't specialized to 
perform well, they must drastically reset 
their mind and body over the summer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And Bright, judging by the Satsuki Sho and 
the Tokyo Yushun, you are unmistakably 
suited for medium distances, just like 
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you seek the same level of perfection 
as I had back then, naturally, the burden 
upon you will be immense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you possess the resolve to see it 
through, even if it means pushing through 
such pain?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The will... to see it through...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course... I have it. A resolve greater, 
stronger, and firmer than anyone's. For I 
am...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you want to dedicate 
yourself to Mejiro even to such an extent?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will not stop at merely serving... I 
wish to become Mejiro's "new light."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Something that can push even further 
beyond the fine examples set by Sister 
Ryan and Lady McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because I have always been a 
burden, I feel that unless I give it 
everything I have, I won't even be able to 
produce the faintest glimmer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Recklessly... toward a new light... 
You..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, Bright is saying this, but it 
is acceptable if I push myself to the 
limit, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If you make them go all out, they'll be 
exhausted to the bone. Do you still wish 
to proceed?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, please do that for them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answer without hesitation. Things will 
be painful now, and we might feel like 
collapsing along the way. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she will always make it in 
time and even the score. Because that is 
who Mejiro Bright is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...You truly have complete faith in her, 
don't you? It is rare to find someone 
willing to wait for Bright for so long."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then let us begin, Bright. The 
way you are now is nowhere near enough. 
Keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes... Lady McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, several days passed—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen, I've finally gotten used to 
running like this~. Do you think I've 
improved a little?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Bright, you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing at all. Still, to think 
it would come this far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us put the finishing touches 
on our special training. The finale shall 
be an exhibition match with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's add a little bit of playfulness to 
it. Trainer, which event would you like to 
have them try?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two options were presented. The event I'd 
like Mejiro Bright and Mejiro McQueen to 
try is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wrestling... Very well. If your stamina 
runs out, you will find yourself rolling 
in the sand in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us change, Bright. We cannot possibly 
wrestle in these outfits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are the rules clear? Grabbing the swimsuit 
is a foul. You must grapple by holding 
onto arms, legs, or waists.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Come at me from wherever you like!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: H-Hwaa... Yaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What is that? What is with that 
completely relaxed stance...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eii...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a tackle straight out of those 
sluggish movements!? Could it be you were 
just trying to catch me off guard... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Movements as elusive as clouds. Whether 
intentional or not, the Bright-style 
wrestling technique completely baffled 
Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, you certainly held on for quite 
a while. Doing this well is more than 
satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ But they went and 
rolled all over the sand~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Mejiro Lady Wrestling match 
concluded. Mejiro Bright emerged even 
stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance swimming... Very well. It 
requires a different kind of stamina 
compared to running on land, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once we change into our swimsuits, let's 
get right to it, Bright. A contest to see 
who can swim to the island and back first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the long-distance swim match 
began, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Slow. Far too slow. I crossed the 
finish line ages ago..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world is she doing? Surely 
nothing has happened to her...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, this would be around the time 
you'd start worrying. But with Mejiro 
Bright, it's totally possible for things 
to take this long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*pant, haaah*... Apologies for keeping you 
waiting, Lady McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, just as expected~. You went and 
lost, didn't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Are you alright!? Whatever were 
you doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Well, on the way, I got caught up in some 
kind of rushing tide, and I went 
whoooosh!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Something like a current... Don't tell me 
you got caught in a rip current?! And then 
what happened...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I figured this was just another trial~. 
So I went with the flow without resisting 
until the very end~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've made my way back, nice and slooow~. 
Thanks to the training from Lady McQueen, 
I managed to pull through somehow~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So you went out of your way to drift away? 
*sigh*... I can't tell if you're carefree 
or just plain reckless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am glad you are safe, though. Trainer, 
you really know how to keep up with this 
girl, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen smiled wryly. It seemed 
this unexpected long-distance swim had 
tempered Mejiro Bright's mental fortitude 
even further.
